infothequecore: Name of the special page and extension, shown in the UI and in [[Special:SpecialPages]].
infothequecore-select-form-label: Label for the content-type selector on Special:InfothequeCore.
infothequecore-select-form-help: Help text shown under the content-type selector.
infothequecore-select-form-submit: Submit button label on the content-type selector step.
infothequecore-field-titre: Field label: non-repeating table title, shared by the Téléchargements-logiciels, Manuels and Configurations forms.
infothequecore-field-edition: Field label: edition name, Téléchargements-logiciels form (maps to editionN).
infothequecore-field-version: Field label: version number, reused across Téléchargements-logiciels, Manuels and Pilotes forms (maps to versionN).
infothequecore-field-langue: Field label: language, reused across Téléchargements-logiciels and Manuels forms (maps to langueN).
infothequecore-field-description: Field label: free description, reused across Téléchargements-logiciels and Manuels forms (maps to descriptionN).
infothequecore-field-format-media: Field label: media icon picker, Téléchargements-logiciels form (maps to formatN, wrapped into a [[Fichier:]] link).
infothequecore-field-image: Field label: photo picker, Téléchargements-logiciels form (maps to imageN, wrapped into a [[Fichier:]] link).
infothequecore-field-liens: Field label: download links, reused across Téléchargements-logiciels and Manuels forms (maps to liensN).
infothequecore-field-nom-document: Field label: document name, Manuels form (maps to editionN).
infothequecore-field-edition-document: Field label: document edition/date, Manuels form (maps to versionN).
infothequecore-field-format-document: Field label: document type icon picker, Manuels form (maps to formatN, wrapped into a [[Fichier:]] link).
infothequecore-field-variante: Field label: variant name, Configurations form (maps to varianteN).
infothequecore-field-processeur: Field label: processor, Configurations form (maps to processeurN).
infothequecore-field-ram: Field label: memory, Configurations form (maps to ramN).
infothequecore-field-stockage: Field label: storage, Configurations form (maps to stockageN).
infothequecore-field-graphics: Field label: graphics card, Configurations form (maps to graphicsN).
infothequecore-field-autres: Field label: free notes, Configurations form (maps to autresN).
infothequecore-field-nom-pilote: Field label: driver name, Pilotes form (maps to nomN).
infothequecore-field-type-pilote: Field label: driver type, Pilotes form (maps to typeN).
infothequecore-field-os-pilote: Field label: target OS, Pilotes form (maps to osN).
infothequecore-field-date-pilote: Field label: driver date, Pilotes form (maps to dateN).
infothequecore-field-fichier-pilote: Field label: uploaded file picker, Pilotes form (maps to fichierN, bare file name, no [[Fichier:]] wrapper).
